decisions.reason: As a close-to-core upholstery launch with dedicated website presentation in a growing market, it shows no clear shortfall versus aspiration and merits continued support.
Although the market signal is modest, this adjacent decorative fabric expands the assortment and, with organisational slack and no evident underperformance, should be retained for another cycle.
Its own-page presentation and flame-retardant functionality fit the firm's contract-textile strengths, so performance appears at least promising enough to stay above a drop threshold.

Despite weaker visibility, it builds on the established offer and helps preserve collection breadth, and there is not enough evidence of results below aspiration to justify reallocating resources yet.
This product extends the firm's decorative textile range in a familiar niche, and with industry growth and no clear failure signal the prudent behavioural choice is to keep it on the market for now.
